test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, 'PORTER' is written as 'RYVALP' and 'REMOTE' is written as 'ELTVAR'. How will 'CLOUDY' be written in the same language?
solution:
Here is the alphabetical place value for each letter:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b4ed79a26f92afc07e86b2f0339fb4b5e5fd0991c1d29a844bcf56e5e448092.png] 

The logic used in this code language is as follows:

 
• The **first letter** of the coded word is the **last letter** of the original word.
 
• The **last letter** of the coded word is the **first letter** of the original word.
 
• All **middle letters** (from the 2nd to the 5th position) of the original word are shifted **forward by 7 positions** in the English alphabetical order to get their corresponding coded letters.

Let's verify this logic with the given examples:

**For 'PORTER' written as 'RYVALP':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed1fb3e4c6924edf8c0eb97e84fe49ab926df32a496cd9aaf5c66875c8360dc1.png] 

**For 'REMOTE' written as 'ELTVAR':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d9715f0ec2bb8fc61ebff1f0731dfb79d2931f8df5ba32442e9e4aeaf6d5b20.png] 

**Applying the same logic to 'CLOUDY':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0aca83d13205aef230296ba1afd7016606b97ccc2ed8406ffbc0570dbc8c4fe9.png] 

Thus, 'CLOUDY' will be written as **YSVBKC**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
